statement: For every m >= 2 and epsilon in (0, 1/2] with integer 1/epsilon, and every agent whose utilities and positive threshold are epsilon-quantized, Algorithm 1 returns an exact representation of that agent's acceptable halfspace using O(m log(1/epsilon)) membership queries.
assumptions: m is an integer at least 2
epsilon is in (0, 1/2] and 1/epsilon is a positive integer
acceptability uses the inclusive expected-utility inequality
acceptance_criteria: every agent in each declared complete finite domain is enumerated
learned and oracle halfspaces agree on every declared audit-grid cell
every query count respects the independently derived envelope
the symbolic normalization derivation covers the continuous simplex
the independent checker passes and two implementation mutations are detected
